label: q36-35b-mlxvlm
version_cmd: import importlib.metadata as m, json; d = m.distribution('mlx-vlm'); print('mlx-vlm', d.version, d.read_text('direct_url.json'), 'mlx', m.version('mlx'))
note: mlx-vlm 0.7.8 (the latest release; MLX_VLM_PYTHON = a Python with it, mlx 0.32.4) on the same MLX 4-bit folder every engine reads (mlx-community's 4-bit conversion with its MTP head as published by MTPLX, Youssofal/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-MTPLX-Optimized-Speed @9546051; mtp.safetensors is not in the index, so the trunk loads without it). Automatic prefix caching on (APC_ENABLED=1, in memory only), mlx-vlm's own switch for reusing a conversation's prefix in follow-up turns (off by default); 2048-token prefill steps (its default, stated); one sequence at a time. The request's model id is the path the server was started with.

label: q36-35b-mlxvlm-dflash2
note: As q36-35b-mlxvlm, with incoai's DFlash2 drafter (incoai/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-DFlash2 @51ef7b6, the drafter Kapitsa and oMLX read; mlx-vlm's dflash2 drafter, bf16) at its default block (5 of the drafter's 8). The fastest of mlx-vlm's setups in short runs before the session (three sampled decodes each; T = 0.6 tok/s: DFlash2 85.2, DFlash2 block 8 81.6, no speculation 81.7). Its MTP path did not load this folder's head: the head of MTPLX's release stores its experts one by one, and mlx-vlm 0.7.8 stacks them only when it converts a Hugging Face checkpoint, not in an MLX-format head.
